content: वनम् [वन्-अच्] .²1 A forest, wood, thicket of trees; एको वासः पत्तने वा वने वा <ls>Bh. 3. 120</ls>; वनेऽपि दोषाः प्रभवन्ति रागिणाम्. .²2 A cluster, group, a quantity of lotuses or other plants growing in a thick bed; चित्रद्विपाः पद्मवनावतीर्णाः <ls>R. 16. 16</ls>, <ls n="R.">6. 86</ls>. .²3 A place of abode, residence, house. .²4 A fountain, spring (of water). .²5 Water in general; गगनं … वनौघनमदभ्रम् <ls>Śi. 6. 73</ls>. .²6 A wooden vessel. .²7 Wood, timber. .²8 Dwelling in a forest, living abroad. .²9 <ab>Ved.</ab> A cloud. .²10 Light, a ray of light. .²11 Worshipping. .²12 A mountain; <ls>L. D. B.</ls> .²13 Plenty, abundance. (As the first member of <ab>comp.</ab> वन may be translated by ‘wild’, ‘forest’; वनवराहः, वनकदली, वनपुष्पम् <ab>&c.</ab>)
